description: Moves a Sitecore item to another parent over the Authoring and Management API, taking its descendants with it. Every link to the item survives the move — prefer this over delete-and-recreate, which breaks them. Supply exactly one of id or path, and exactly one of targetParentId or targetParentPath.

database.description: The database holding the item. Defaults to master.

id.description: The item's GUID. Supply this or path.

path.description: The item's full path. Supply this or id.

sortOrder.description: The sort order to give the item under its new parent.

targetParentId.description: The GUID of the parent to move into. Supply this or targetParentPath.

targetParentPath.description: The path of the parent to move into. Supply this or targetParentId.

name: authoring-move-item
